value.en: After Yan's execution, the emperor sent the southern central army's staff officer Xiao Jichang to strike down and kill Xu.
value.literal: When Yan was executed, the emperor also sent the southern central army's staff officer Xiao Jichang to strike Xu and kill him.

value.zh: 王景，萊州掖人，家世力田。
value.en: Wang Jing came from Ye in Laizhou. His family had farmed the land for generations.
value.literal: Wang Jing was a native of Ye in Laizhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.

value.zh: 景少倜儻，善騎射，不事生業，結里中惡少為群盜。
value.en: In youth he was daring and free-spirited, an excellent horseman and archer who shunned honest work and banded with neighborhood troublemakers as outlaws.
value.literal: When young, Jing was bold and unconventional, skilled at mounted archery, did not pursue a livelihood, and joined local ruffians as a band of robbers.

value.zh: 梁大將王檀鎮滑臺，以景隸麾下，與後唐莊宗戰河上，檀有功，景嘗左右之。
value.en: Liang general Wang Tan held Huatai and took Jing into his service. In the river battles against Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong, Tan earned distinction, and Jing was often at his side.
value.literal: The Liang general Wang Tan garrisoned Huatai and placed Jing under his command; when fighting Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, Tan won merit and Jing often assisted at his side.

value.zh: 莊宗入汴，景來降，累遷奉聖都虞候。
value.en: After Zhuangzong took Bian, Jing submitted and rose through successive posts to commandant of the Fengsheng Guard.
value.literal: When Zhuangzong entered Bian, Jing came to surrender and was repeatedly promoted to commandant of the Fengsheng Guard.

value.zh: 清泰末，從張敬達圍晉陽，會契丹來援，景以所部歸晉祖。
value.en: Late in the Qingtai reign he joined Zhang Jingda's siege of Jinyang. When Khitan forces marched to relieve the city, Jing defected with his troops to the future Jin emperor.
value.literal: At the end of the Qingtai era he followed Zhang Jingda in besieging Jinyang; when the Khitan came to relieve the city, Jing brought his command over to the Jin founding emperor.

value.zh: 王晏，徐州滕人，家世力田。
value.en: Wang Yan came from Teng in Xuzhou. His family had farmed for generations.
value.literal: Wang Yan was a native of Teng in Xuzhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.

value.zh: 晏少壯勇無賴，嘗率群寇行攻劫。
value.en: In youth Yan was fierce and lawless and led gangs in robbery and pillage.
value.literal: When young Yan was bold, fierce, and unruly; he once led a band of robbers in raids and plunder.

value.zh: 梁末，徐方大亂，屬邑皆為他盜所剽，惟晏鄉里恃晏獲全。
value.en: Late in the Liang, chaos engulfed Xu. Neighboring districts were looted by other bandits, but Yan's home village alone was spared because of him.
value.literal: At the end of Liang, the Xu region was greatly disturbed; subordinate districts were all plundered by other bandits, but only Yan's home village, relying on Yan, was kept intact.

value.zh: 後唐同光中，應募隸禁軍，累遷奉國小校。
value.en: Under Later Tang in the Tongguang era he enlisted in the palace army and rose to junior officer of the Fengguo Guard.
value.literal: In the Later Tang Tongguang era he answered the levy and joined the palace army, rising through posts to junior officer of the Fengguo Guard.

value.zh: 晉開運末，與本軍都校趙暉、忠衛都校侯章等戍陜州。
value.en: Late in the Jin Kaiyun reign he garrisoned Shaanzhou with his colonel Zhao Hui, Zhongwei colonel Hou Zhang, and others.
value.literal: At the end of Jin Kaiyun, together with his army's colonel Zhao Hui, the Zhongwei Guard's colonel Hou Zhang, and others, he garrisoned Shaanzhou.

value.zh: 會契丹至汴，遣其將劉愿據陜，恣行暴虐，晏與暉等謀曰：「今契丹南侵，天下洶洶，英雄豪傑固當乘時自奮。
value.en: When the Khitan took Bian they sent Liu Yuan to hold Shaan, where he ruled with savage cruelty. Yan and Hui plotted together: "The Khitan are south, the realm is in chaos—this is the hour for a true man to rise.
value.literal: When the Khitan reached Bian, they sent their general Liu Yuan to hold Shaan and wantonly practiced cruelty and oppression. Yan and Hui and the others plotted, saying: "Now the Khitan invade south and the realm is in turmoil; heroes and great men ought surely to seize the moment and rouse themselves.

value.zh: 且聞太原劉公威德遠被，人心歸服，若殺愿送款河東，為天下倡首，則取富貴如反掌耳。」
value.en: We hear that Liu of Taiyuan's fame reaches far and men flock to him. Kill Yuan, open the gates to Hedong, and lead the realm—fortune and rank would be ours in a stroke."
value.literal: Moreover we hear that Lord Liu of Taiyuan's prestige and virtue extend far and men's hearts submit to him. If we kill Yuan and send allegiance to Hedong, taking the lead for the realm, then gaining wealth and rank would be like turning the palm."

value.zh: 暉等然之。
value.en: Hui and the rest agreed.
value.literal: Hui and the others agreed.

value.zh: 晏乃率敢死士數人夜踰城，入府署，劫庫兵給其徒，遲明，斬愿首級府門外。
value.en: Yan led a handful of daredevils over the wall by night into the yamen, seized arms from the arsenal for his men, and at dawn cut off Yuan's head and hung it outside the gate.
value.literal: Yan then led several dare-to-die men by night over the wall, entered the prefectural compound, seized weapons from the arsenal for his followers, and at dawn beheaded Yuan and displayed his head outside the prefectural gate.

value.zh: 眾請暉為帥，章為本城副指揮使、內外巡檢使兼都虞候；
value.en: The troops made Hui their commander. Zhang became deputy garrison commander, patrol commissioner inside and out, and commandant as well;
value.literal: The multitude asked Hui to be commander; Zhang was made deputy commander of the local garrison, inner and outer patrol commissioner, and concurrent commandant.

value.zh: 遣其子漢倫奉表晉陽。
value.en: and Yan sent his son Hanlun to Jinyang with a letter of submission.
value.literal: they sent his son Hanlun to present a memorial at Jinyang.

value.zh: 時漢祖雖建號，威聲未振，得晏等來歸，甚喜，即日以暉為保平軍節度，章為鎮國軍節度，晏為絳州防禦使，仍領舊職。
value.en: The Han emperor had taken the throne but his name still rang small. Yan's defection delighted him. That same day he made Hui governor of Baoping, Zhang of Zhenguo, and Yan defender of Jiangzhou while keeping their old posts.
value.literal: At that time though the Han founding emperor had established his title, his prestige was not yet strong; receiving Yan and the others coming over, he was greatly pleased. That very day he made Hui military governor of Baoping, Zhang military governor of Zhenguo, and Yan defender of Jiangzhou, each retaining former duties.

value.zh: 既而暉等表晏始謀功為第一，遷建雄軍節度。
value.en: Hui and the others then reported that Yan had conceived the plot and deserved first credit. He was promoted to military governor of Jianxiong.
value.literal: Soon Hui and the others memorialized that Yan's merit in initiating the plot was foremost, and he was transferred to military governor of Jianxiong.

value.zh: 漢祖入汴，加同平章事。
value.en: When the Han emperor entered Bian, Yan was made co-equal chief councilor.
value.literal: When the Han founding emperor entered Bian, Yan was given the additional title of co-equal chief councilor.

value.zh: 初，晏至鎮，悉召故時同為盜者遺以金帛，從容置酒語之曰：「吾鄉素多盜，我與諸君昔嘗為之。
value.en: When Yan first took his post he summoned his old bandit comrades, gave them gold and silk, and over wine said gently, "Our country has always had its thieves—you and I were among them once.
value.literal: When Yan first reached his command, he summoned all who had formerly been robbers with him, gave them gold and silk, and over wine said at ease: "Our district has always had many bandits; you and I once did this together.

value.zh: 後來者固當出諸君之下，為我告諭，令不復為，若不能改，吾必盡滅其族。」
value.en: Anyone who comes after you must stay beneath you. Tell them to stop—or I will wipe out their families to the last man."
value.literal: Those who come later should surely rank below you; convey this for me and tell them not to do it again. If they cannot reform, I will exterminate their clans to the last."

value.zh: 由是境內安靜，吏民詣闕舉留，請為晏立衣錦碑。
value.en: The district grew quiet. Officials and commoners petitioned the throne to keep him and asked for a "glorious return" stele in his honor.
value.literal: Thereby the territory within became peaceful and quiet; officials and people went to court to petition to retain him and asked to erect for Yan a "return in glory" stele.

value.zh: 世宗初，復請立德政碑。
value.en: Early in Shizong's reign they asked again for a stele praising his rule.
value.literal: At the beginning of Shizong's reign they again asked to erect a stele of virtuous administration.

value.zh: 世宗命比部郎中、知制誥張正撰文賜之，詔改其鄉里為使相鄉勳德里，私門立戟。
value.en: Shizong had Zhang Zheng compose the inscription, renamed his home village Xunde Lane in Ministers' Township, and ordered halberds set before his gate.
value.literal: Shizong ordered Zhang Zheng, director of the Ministry of Revenue's comparisons bureau and drafter of edicts, to compose the text and bestow it; an edict changed his home village to Xunde Lane in the Xiangxiang of chief ministers, and halberds were set up at his private gate.

value.zh: 未幾，改河南尹、西京留守。
value.en: Soon he was made metropolitan magistrate of Henan and regent of the western capital.
value.literal: Before long he was made metropolitan magistrate of Henan and western capital regent.

value.zh: 顯德三年，移鳳翔節度。
value.en: In the third Xiande year he was transferred to Fengxiang as military governor.
value.literal: In the third year of Xiande he was transferred to military governor of Fengxiang.

value.zh: 六年，從世宗北征，為益津關一路馬軍都部署，韓令坤副焉，遂平三關。
value.en: In the sixth year he joined Shizong's northern campaign as cavalry commander on the Yijin route with Han Lingkun as deputy, and helped secure the three frontier passes.
value.literal: In the sixth year he followed Shizong on the northern campaign as overall commander of cavalry on the Yijin Pass route, with Han Lingkun as deputy, and thereby pacified the three passes.

value.zh: 太祖即位，進封趙國公。
value.en: When Taizu took the throne, Yan was advanced to Duke of Zhao.
value.literal: When Taizu took the throne, Yan was advanced to Duke of Zhao.

value.zh: 從征李筠，師還，改安遠軍節度。
value.en: He joined the campaign against Li Yun and, on the army's return, was made military governor of Anyuan.
value.literal: He followed the campaign against Li Yun; when the army returned he was made military governor of Anyuan.

value.zh: 乾德元年，進封韓國公，上章請老，拜太子太師致仕。
value.en: In the first Qiande year he was raised to Duke of Han, asked to retire, and was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with permission to leave office.
value.literal: In the first year of Qiande he was advanced to Duke of Han, submitted a memorial requesting retirement, and was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with retirement from office.

value.zh: 每朝會，令綴中書門下班。
value.en: At court assemblies he was placed in the row just after the chief ministers.
value.literal: At each court assembly he was ordered to take place in the row after the Zhongshu Gate class.

value.zh: 俄歸洛陽別墅。
value.en: Before long he withdrew to his villa at Luoyang.
value.literal: Soon he returned to his villa at Luoyang.

value.zh: 四年冬，卒，年七十七。
value.en: He died in the winter of the fourth year, at seventy-seven.
value.literal: In the winter of the fourth year he died, aged seventy-seven.

value.zh: 廢朝三日，贈中書令。
value.en: Court mourned three days and posthumously made him Chief Secretary.
value.literal: Court was suspended for three days; he was posthumously made Chief Secretary.

value.zh: 初，晏為軍校，與平陸人王興善，其妻亦相為娣姒。
value.en: When Yan was still a junior officer he was close to Wang Xing of Pinglu, and their wives were sisters-in-law.
value.literal: Earlier, when Yan was an army officer, he was on good terms with Wang Xing of Pinglu; their wives were also sisters-in-law to each other.

value.zh: 晏既貴，乃薄興，興不能平。
value.en: Once Yan rose high he snubbed Xing, who could not bear the slight.
value.literal: After Yan became eminent he treated Xing coldly; Xing could not accept this.

value.zh: 晏妻病，興語人曰：「吾能治之。」
value.en: When Yan's wife fell ill, Xing told people, "I can cure her."
value.literal: When Yan's wife fell ill, Xing told others: "I can cure her."

value.zh: 晏遽訪興，興曰：「我非能醫，但以公在陜時止一妻，今妓妾甚眾，得非待糟糠之薄，致夫人怏怏成疾耶？
value.en: Yan rushed to see him. Xing said, "I am no physician—but in Shaan you had one wife and now a houseful of concubines. Have you neglected the woman who stood by you in poverty and made your lady sick with grief?
value.literal: Yan hurried to visit Xing. Xing said: "I am not able to practice medicine, but when you were at Shaan you had only one wife; now your singing girls and concubines are very many—could it not be that treating your wife of humble days too lightly has made the lady displeased and brought on illness?

value.zh: 若能斥去女侍，夫人之疾可立愈。」
value.en: Send the concubines away and your wife will recover at once."
value.literal: If you can drive away the female attendants, the lady's illness can be cured at once."

value.zh: 晏以為謗己，乃誣以他事，悉案誅其夫妻。
value.en: Yan took this for slander, trumped up other charges, and had husband and wife executed together.
value.literal: Yan thought Xing was slandering him, so he fabricated other charges and had husband and wife investigated and executed together.

value.zh: 守西洛日，白重贊鎮河陽，時世宗征淮南，重贊慮幷人乘間為寇，因葺城壘，且約晏為援。
value.en: While Yan held the western capital, Bai Chongzan held Heyang. Shizong was campaigning in Huainan, and Chongzan feared the Bingzhou forces might strike while he was weak, so he strengthened his walls and asked Yan for support.
value.literal: While holding the western capital, Bai Chongzan garrisoned Heyang. At that time Shizong was campaigning in Huainan; Chongzan feared the Bing people would seize the interval to raid, so he repaired walls and ramparts and also arranged with Yan as reinforcement.

value.zh: 晏意欲兼有三城，即與漢倫同率兵赴之。
value.en: Yan meant to seize all three cities for himself and marched with Hanlun to Heyang.
value.literal: Yan intended to take all three cities for himself and immediately led troops with Hanlun to go to his aid.

value.zh: 重贊聞其來，拒不納，遣人語之曰：「公在陜州已立大功，河陽小城不煩枉駕。」
value.en: Chongzan heard he was coming and shut the gates, sending word: "You won great glory at Shaanzhou. This little town of Heyang hardly needs your presence."
value.literal: Chongzan heard he was coming, refused to admit him, and sent someone to say: "Your Lordship already achieved great merit at Shaanzhou; this small city of Heyang does not trouble you to come in person."

value.zh: 慚不能對，遂引兵還。
value.en: Yan, shamed, had no answer and marched home.
value.literal: Ashamed, Yan could not reply and thereupon led his troops back.

value.zh: 周祖即位，加兼侍中。
value.en: When the Zhou founder acceded, Yan was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
value.literal: When the Zhou founder acceded, [Yan] was given the additional title of concurrent Palace Attendant.

value.zh: 廣順元年，劉崇侵晉州，晏閉關不出，設伏城上。
value.en: In the first Guangshun year, Liu Chong invaded Jinzhou. Yan shut the gates and refused to emerge, posting ambushes on the walls.
value.literal: In the first year of Guangshun, Liu Chong invaded Jinzhou; Yan closed the passes and would not come out, setting ambushes atop the walls.
